cache.chooseBody:
Choose a cache location for the portable version.

The app creates a PhoneticToolbox-cache folder here for runtime files, downloaded updates and ordinary browser caches. Other graphics caches can be viewed and cleaned in Settings.
This folder remains in use after replacing the EXE. When you stop using the app, you can delete it after closing the app.
Settings, drafts, recordings and research data remain in their original locations.

Click OK to choose a location, or Cancel to exit.
